parsed.name: A-Star轮速编码器
parsed.description: 这是一种安装在移动小车车轮上的旋转编码器测速装置，通常与A-Star控制板配合使用，用于根据车轮转动脉冲计算轮速和车辆行驶速度，常见于机器人小车与自动驾驶实验平台。
parsed.description_en: This is a wheel-mounted rotary encoder speed sensing device, typically used with an A-Star controller board, for calculating wheel speed and vehicle motion from encoder ticks. It is commonly used in robotic cars and autonomous vehicle lab platforms.

actions.description: 更新轮速编码器读数并计算当前速度。
actions.description_en: Update the wheel encoder reading and compute the current speed.

actions.description: 以线程化方式返回当前轮速测量值。
actions.description_en: Return the current wheel speed measurement in threaded operation.

actions.description: 停止轮速编码器的后台采集过程。
actions.description_en: Stop the background acquisition process of the wheel speed encoder.
